chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Ammar al-Sabati, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
Is then he who follows the pleasure of Allah like him who has incurred wrath from Allah, and whose refuge is Hell? And evil is the destination. They are of varying degrees with Allah.

So he said: Those who follow the pleasure of Allah are the Imams, and by Allah, O Ammar, they are degrees for the believers. Through their wilayah and their recognition of us, Allah multiplies their deeds for them and raises them to the highest degrees.

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: the Imams as the divinely appointed guides
key_terms.بِوَلَايَتِهِمْ: through their wilayah, meaning loyal adherence to the authority of the Imams
key_terms.دَرَجَاتٌ: spiritual ranks or levels with Allah
key_terms.رِضْوَانَ اللَّهِ: the pleasure and approval of Allah
key_terms.مَعْرِفَتِهِمْ: through knowledge and recognition of them

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام interpret the verse about following the pleasure of Allah and the degrees with Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse as referring to the Imams عليهم السلام as those who follow the pleasure of Allah. It teaches that the believers attain higher degrees through wilayah of the Imams and recognition of them, and that Allah multiplies their deeds and raises their ranks accordingly.
